lesson_ratings.title: جمال المحيط
lesson_ratings.reason: Rich vocabulary about nature, dreams, and ocean life with varied sentence structures.

lesson_ratings.title: السمك الفرحان جوة المحيط
lesson_ratings.reason: Introduces fish, emotions, and contrasting situations with useful everyday phrases.

lesson_ratings.title: متعة وأمان جوة المحيط
lesson_ratings.reason: Teaches expressions about safety and impossibility, though some lines are repetitive.

lesson_ratings.title: الرقص جوة المحيط
lesson_ratings.reason: Introduces sea creatures and dance-related vocabulary, but chorus repeats earlier themes.

lesson_ratings.title: الأوركسترا الكبير
lesson_ratings.reason: New vocabulary about orchestra and shells, but limited distinct content.
